method: Generated a fresh 208-215 total3/total4 public bounded source, reran the pre-factor FFE gate, Sage factorization, prefactor unique-leaf root policy, direct frozen fourth-leaf trigger replay, exploratory marginal controls, the full root-diversity paired marginal replay, found the row-level diagnostic contamination, reran transfer-211 Sage factorization on exact row/leaf profiles, replayed the shared public linear factor as a leaf gate, audited public x-match orientation and shared-leaf charges across 192-199, 200-207, and 208-215, then preregistered the same shared-factor package on a fresh later 216-223 source. The later-window leaf-90 package verified a relation-derived secret but did not beat rho. A new leaf-79 exact-profile pass on 216-223 produced an in-window measured below-rho replay, but the frozen leaf-79 public line and candidate-position orientation package did not stay below rho on unseen 224-231. Exact-profile Sage on the 224-231 transfer-227 leaf-79 rows kept the algebraic signal alive and localized the remaining loss to public x-match orientation. Added a public where-rule DSL and rule miner; support=0+5 with scheduled_trial=1 gives measured below-rho recoveries on 216-223 and 232-239 but fails on 224-231 and clean holdout 240-247 without activation. Added public case-level activation filtering and mined activate:row_xmatch_counts=0,2,2&salt_mod3_residue0_count=1 from 216-247. The frozen activation plus support rule validates fresh on 248-255 with a measured below-rho secret recovery at 135/137 rho, but does not activate on 256-263 or 264-271. The transfer-255 exact-profile audit shows the two support-rule relation-bearing rows share the preserving public line 270*b + c + 2514. A factor-line mechanism audit across 216-271 confirms all three unique verified support systems are exactly explained by this line's selected-root rows; transfer 227 has the line but only one selected-root row and does not recover. Direct replay through 270*b + c + 2514 reproduces the same wins and misses, so the executable replay line and exact-profile mechanism match. A farther 272-287 holdout keeps producing broad low-cost 22050 public candidates, but direct line-270 replay activates none of them; the updated 216-287 audit still has exactly the same three mechanism-matched support systems. Exact profiles for the first transfer-277 and transfer-285 far-holdout candidates expose repeated cheap degree-1 factors but no selected-root pairs; broader exact profiling then finds verified selected-root target-cap1 rows. Fresh 288-303 validation confirms target-cap1 public recoveries beyond 272-279, and public replay through per-window degree-1 lines derives secrets below rho. The new target-cap1 predictor freezes public leaf-signature rules and validates on unseen 304-319: 7 of 8 selected public systems are verified below rho, and exact line replay derives fresh secrets on transfers 310 and 319. The same frozen 22050 v1 predictor fails on 320-335 with zero selected systems, so the branch is split; a narrow target-67 v2 predictor frozen from pre-320 signature [0,1,2,3] validates on held-out transfer 330, exact profiling finds 945*b + c + 952, and public line replay derives secret 255 at 0.544 rho. The target-67 v2 predictor then fails on 336-351 with zero selected systems, but the original 22050 v1 predictor naturally reactivates on transfer 341: 5 selected systems, 2 verified below rho, exact profiling finds 3093*b + c + 5884 for [8,34,56,90], and public line replay derives secret 5689 at 0.35036496 rho. A public multi-branch scheduler calibrated on 272-351 then validates unchanged on 352-367: it selects 3 systems from 414 public cases, all 3 verify below rho, and exact FFE plus public replay for transfer 353 finds 6110*b + c + 4058 and derives secret 5675 at 0.35036496 rho. The same scheduler then abstains unchanged on 368-383, where target-cap1 has zero verified stress rows/leaves and the public bounded sources are global/target-cap3 dominated with rank-0 cheap cases. On 384-399 the old branches false-positive on rank-0 22050 rows, while a post-hoc target-67 v3 signature [1,5,6] yields exact line 3394*b + c + 711 and public replay secret 6208 at 0.448 rho. On 400-415 the augmented v3 scheduler abstains in another target-cap3/global hole, so v3 remains unvalidated but does not overselect there. Added public branch precedence, contains signatures, and salt-set guarded branches. A pair-family target-67 {5,6}/salt206 scan explains transfer 427 with exact line 1119*b + c + 7180 and public replay secret 4698 at 0.56 rho, but this family was recognized after 424-431. A true forward 432-447 check reactivates the old target-67 v2 branch on transfer 437 at 0.656 rho, while exact profiling finds no preserving linear factor, separating relation-layer row selection from line-backed FFE recovery. Fresh 448-463 validation selected four rows under the frozen scheduler: three 22050 false positives and one verified target-67 v2 row at transfer 449. Exact profiling found a preserving line 8741*b + c + 499 for the verified v2 row, but public orientation replay verified no rule. A post-hoc salt-relaxed pair56 diagnostic found that transfer 449 salt204 reuses line 3394*b + c + 711 and a 456-463 control reuses line 1119*b + c + 7180, but both line replays fail under current public orientation rules. Added a target-67 line-family activation miner to separate public x-match event features from verifier labels. Mined and froze a public target-67 line-family activation rule, activate:top_k=7&xmatch_count>=6|xmatch_count>=8, from known target-67 line successes/failures. Fresh 464-479 validation selected exactly one target-67 v2 row, transfer 473 at 0.568 rho; exact profiling found 9481*b + c + 5654 with root-scan 0.776 rho; replay with the frozen activation rule derived secret 7675 at 0.448 rho. Fresh 480-495 validation kept the activation rule frozen and ran the unchanged scheduler on 358 bounded cases; it selected three old 22050 rows, all verifier-negative, selected no target-67 rows, and the bucket report classified the window as a branch-reach failure rather than an activation-rule replay test. Added a target-67 line-stage audit over exact-profile and replay artifacts from 328-495. The audit confirms repeated preserving degree-1 lines and four replay recoveries, but shows that no replay-success row remains below rho when exact line confirmation/root-scan is naively added to replay cost; the minimum line-plus-replay charge is 1.216 rho. The same audit computes break-even reuse counts: all replay-success rows need only n=2 reuse for line-confirmation-plus-replay to fall below rho, while adding row-selection cost leaves only one finite break-even at n=33. Added a repeated-line amortization probe and fixed-line future checks for lines 1119 and 3394. The probe finds two repeated line-present families, but zero repeated families with two replay-success rows; the 480-495 fixed-line checks activate zero cases. Generated fresh 496-503 and 504-511 stress/public-bounded windows. The 496-503 target-67 top-16 post-hoc branch exposes line 8022*b + c + 5592 with below-rho root scans but no public orientation replay; the same top-16 branch abstains on 504-511 while the old 22050 scheduler validates there. Mined and replayed the public orientation rule where:candidate_eq_scheduled across all nine line-present target-67 cases; it activates all cases but verifies zero keys, showing that the one-relation slice fails the rank-2 boundary. A rank-aware orientation miner over already-replayed public rules selects all as the current best baseline, with 4 true positives, 0 false positives, and 0 false negatives. Re-mined line-success activation with transfers <=463 as training and later transfers as validation; the existing rule activate:top_k=7&xmatch_count>=6|xmatch_count>=8 gets 3/0/0 on training and 1/0/0 on later line-present cases. Audited public feature dictionaries for predicting preserving lines across cutoffs 431, 463, and 495; none uniquely predict any later preserving line, including replay-success lines. Audited post-factor residual factor-cloud heuristics and found the best simple ranking hits only 1/4 replay-success lines. Added a pre-bivariate-factorization axis-root line-lift audit; c-axis roots plus selected leaf monic points recover all 9 known preserving lines and all 4 replay-success lines, with singleton candidate sets for replay-success surfaces. Fresh 512-519 and 520-527 exact-profile diagnostics extend that axis-root lead to new over-rho target-cap3 packages: line 945 and line 3394 both reappear as singleton lines on selected-root-positive rows and both derive secrets at 1.272 rho. The 520-527 target-cap1 branch also reaches below-rho public candidates, but they are rank 0 and verifier-negative. The target-67 blocker is now rank-positive target-cap1 branch reach or strict repeated-line amortization with explicit axis-root lift plus replay costs.
